items.docs:
Filter locations with one of the following items:
- { search: { name: string, storeNumber: string, pickupLocationAddress: string } } you can pass search and filter locations by name, storeNumber, pickupLocationAddress includes search 
- or
- { locationIds: [ uuid ] } you can pass locationIds as an array of locationId and search in locations by their id or ids
